endpoints.name: search
endpoints.description: Searches tickets, users and organizations with Zendesk’s query syntax, e.g. type:ticket status:open.

notes.query: The search query. See [Query basics](#query-basics) above. For details on the query syntax, see the [Zendesk Support search reference](https://support.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/4408886879258)
notes.sort_by: One of `updated_at`, `created_at`, `priority`, `status`, or `ticket_type`. Defaults to sorting by relevance

endpoints.name: list_view_tickets
endpoints.description: Lists the tickets in a view.

notes.view_id: The ID of the view, or one of the string aliases `"incoming"`, `"my"`, or `"my_groups"`.
notes.sort_by: Sort or group the tickets by a column in the [View columns](#view-columns) table. The `subject` and `submitter` columns are not supported
notes.sort_order: One of "asc" or "desc". Defaults to "asc" for alphabetical and position sort, "desc" for all others

endpoints.name: update_ticket
endpoints.description: Updates a ticket; a comment with "public": true is seen by the requester. Body: {"ticket": {"status", "comment": {"body", "public"}}}.
